clips.title: The story
paras: A Gyromechanic Gear is a salvaged piece of precision engineering recovered from the fallout outside Gnomeregan. Gnomish inventors in Kharanos seek these specific gears to construct an experimental device capable of reversing leper gnome mutations.

When radiation flooded Gnomeregan to purge the trogg invasion, it corrupted a vast portion of the surviving gnome population into mad, irradiated leper gnomes. Refusing to abandon their twisted kin, inventors Ozzie Togglevolt and Razzle Sprysprocket set to work drafting schematics for the Recombobulator—an ambitious contraption designed to undo the radiation's horrific effects. Building the prototype requires precision mechanisms capable of enduring volatile internal pressures, particularly Gyromechanic Gears and complementary Restabilization Cogs. Because local manufacturing collapsed with the fall of their capital, researchers are forced to scavenge these delicate parts directly from the hostile leper gnomes roaming Dun Morogh.
